hero.bulletOneContent: Hands-on experience building and maintaining backend systems, from legacy applications to modern cloud-native solutions. Proficient in Java, Node.js, and Python, with distributed systems, cloud, and production observability (New Relic).
hero.bulletTwoContent: Undergraduate student in Internet Systems (FATEC), with experience as a Programming Logic teaching assistant. Completed an academic exchange through FATEC at the Polytechnic Institute of Bragança (Portugal), with coursework delivered entirely in English.
hero.bulletThreeContent: Builds AI-powered solutions and uses AI-assisted engineering daily — integrations, automation, and code review with a focus on quality and shipping. Experience with Python and cloud services to optimize processes and deliver measurable business impact.
